title: Last-Mile Delivery Operations
thesis: Snowflake turns daily zone activity from a fictional Philippine e-commerce courier into delivery success and disruption KPIs, 7-day delivery-disruption risk scores, hub-to-door time anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Delivery success rate, failed deliveries, delivery disruption hours and delivered value in PHP for 40 delivery zones across Quezon City, Caloocan City, Cebu City, Davao City and Cagayan de Oro City.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to zone-day rows.
The disruption-cause chart shows which causes cost the most hours, including the two typhoon flooding days.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of last-mile KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which zones should the hub network team watch first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each zone's probability of a delivery disruption in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent 14 labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags hub-to-door time outliers per zone, and the forecast projects network-wide failed deliveries for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: Are rider payouts and compliance keeping up?

talking_points: Rider payout on-time rate, rider document coverage and pending checks frame the capacity-side gaps.
Payout on-time rate against disruption hours by zone shows where late payouts and disruptions move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, zone, disruption-cause and risk tables only.
show: Payout on-time rate and document coverage
Payout on-time rate vs disruption hours
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a delivery attempt fails right now?

talking_points: Live delivery-attempt events land in RAW.LIVE_DELIVERIES, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs FAILED attempts with an SOP hint and the zone's current risk band, then emails the on-call hub supervisor.
tabs.call_out: From a failed attempt to an incident in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 18 synthetic delivery disruption SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
